limits: Six fresh processes are independent; rounds, graphs and trace calls are paired dependent observations.
All completed-start query outcomes remain in primary statistics; query completion is inconclusive.
Absolute GPU-event microseconds describe these replay recipes, not model/serving performance.
Wall spans include deliberate prequeue and are diagnostic only, never a10m/40m latency claim.
Batch length and prequeue differ together for5120/noqueue versus16/queued. No pure host-cost subtraction.
CI crossing1 does not establish equivalence; compare width/sensitivity to contextual0.65percent without a validity gate.
